diagnosis: The induction is appropriate, but simplification alone does not use the induction hypotheses to distribute subset membership through the recursive `app`, `quant`, `ite`, and `eq` cases. One `app` branch also leaves membership in the default empty list. Unfolding `default` and finishing the resulting propositional goals with `grind` closes them.
proof_body:
by
  intro Hnorm
  induction Hnorm
  case app =>
    unfold extractOldExprVars
    split <;>
      simp_all [default, Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars,
        Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.Subset]
    all_goals grind
  all_goals
    simp_all [default, extractOldExprVars,
      Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars,
      Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.Subset]
    grind
